services.name: Tasting Room
services.desc: Enjoy an elevated tasting featuring a selection of our Pinot Noirs. Our wine team will guide you through a flight of five of our award-winning Pinot Noirs, comparing vintages and different blocks within the estate. 90 minute experience $50 per guest - $20 per

blurb: Guests can enjoy a tasting experience on the Dickinson House lawn, take an ATV vineyard tour to estate views, or take a helicopter tour. The estate is open Thursday through Sunday from 12pm to 5pm. Private events can be arranged.

quotes.text: We are thrilled to be named as one of the world's Top 100 Wineries. To be included with our peers in this list is humbling for a brand as relatively young as ours, but absolutely indicative of where we believe we are taking it.
